description: List Harness sessions, newest first, to find a session_id: session_id, title, cwd, updated_at, running and bridge_runs. No paging: raise limit or narrow it with cwd or query. Read-only. Sessions not in dsh_list_sessions are archived or gone: do not look for them on disk.

cwd.description: Only sessions of this workspace folder

query.description: Case-insensitive text to match in title, folder or session id

name: dsh_list_sessions
